name: worktree-warmup
description: Installs a new or stale worktree's dependencies in the background when its session starts, with progress above the message box; Claude's commands that need them wait

command.title: Setup command
command.description: What runs in a new worktree, from its root, under the node version .nvmrc names when nvm is installed

trigger.title: Only with this file
trigger.description: The setup runs only in a worktree that has this file at its root, and again whenever it is newer than the install

installed.title: Install record
installed.description: The file an install writes, whose age says whether the install is older than the trigger file

requires.title: Also required
requires.description: Comma-separated paths a ready worktree also has, such as files the setup command generates; one missing runs the setup
